name: ui_phase
meaning: per-screen phase 0..3 (init, frame, body, event loop)
evidence: every scr*_handler; layer_end FFEF036F increments it

name: frame_latched
meaning: latched IPC frame: [0] opcode hi, [1] item code, [0x20..] values

name: frame_pending
meaning: newest received IPC frame

name: ui_8D79
meaning: cleared before every full redraw; meaning unknown

name: ui_hdr_resync
meaning: set by FFEF40BA when frame bytes 0x13/0x1A change; blocks ui_next_event

name: ui_lang
meaning: 0 = Japanese strings/JIS glyphs, else English

name: ui_event
meaning: last event / touch zone taken from ui_events (0xFF none)

name: ui_blink_armed
meaning: one-shot flag: blink timer registered for this screen

name: lcd_xfer_pending
meaning: queued layer transfers; events wait while >0

name: pict_state
meaning: picture decoder state, 2 = picture ready (Inferred)

name: ui_events
meaning: 64 event bits (lo 0..31, hi 32..63); bit 15 = value changed, 16+ = rows/soft keys
evidence: FFEEFEA4/FFEEFEEE set, FFEEFFEA clear, FFEF003F pick

name: ui_layer
meaning: off-screen layer {flag,slot,x,y,w,h,buf@0x704B000+n*0x25800}

name: blink_timer
meaning: blink timer: +4 phase bit0, +8 lo mask, +0xC hi mask of events re-posted per tick

name: softkey_slot_rects
meaning: per-slot base of soft-key rectangles (8 B each) (doc 79)

name: title_glyphs_690B0
meaning: bitmap glyph pointers (word 0 = width) for screen 0x29 title; also 0x690BC[5], 0x690D0[3], 0x690DC[4], 0x690EC[3] row icons

name: title_glyphs_690F8
meaning: 11-glyph title of item 0xD3; 0x69124[11] for item 0x65

name: scr2C_info_height
meaning: info panel height by (code & 0xF)

name: kbd_field_rect
meaning: keyboard edit-field rect by kbd type

name: item_value_rect
meaning: value-area rect by item code hi/lo nibble

name: bit_mask_u32
meaning: 1<<i (ROM)

name: key_rects
meaning: keyboard key rectangles (ROM)

name: title_len_by_group
meaning: group title length in characters, centring on 13-px pitch (ROM)

name: screen_table
meaning: SUB screen handler table; [0x1F],[0x20],[0x29]-[0x2C] are in this range (ROM)
